description: This source file contains unit tests for the CreateOrder method of the OrderService class within the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It tests scenarios such as basket not found, empty basket, and successful order creation with snapshot and URI composition.

classes.name: CreateOrder
classes.description: Contains unit tests for OrderService.CreateOrderAsync method, testing error conditions and successful order creation including item snapshots and URI composition.

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketNotFound
methods.description: Tests that CreateOrderAsync throws ArgumentNullException when the basket is not found.

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketEmpty
methods.description: Tests that CreateOrderAsync throws EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException when the basket is empty.

methods.name: CreatesOrderWithSnapshotAndComposedUris
methods.description: Tests successful order creation with correct snapshot of basket items, image URI composition, and order item details.
